definitions.explanation: A group of trees smaller than a forest, often in or near populated areas.

examples.japanese: {林|はやし}の{中|なか}を{散歩|さんぽ}した。
examples.english: I took a walk through the woods.

examples.japanese: {家|いえ}の{近|ちか}くに{林|はやし}があります。
examples.english: There's a grove near my house.

examples.japanese: {竹林|ちくりん}が{美|うつく}しい。
examples.notes: 竹林 uses different reading (ちくりん)

notes:
{林|はやし} refers to a smaller wooded area than {森|もり} (forest).

{林|はやし} vs {森|もり}:
- {林|はやし}: woods, grove (smaller, often human-managed)
- {森|もり}: forest (larger, more natural/wild)

COMMON COMPOUNDS:
- {竹林|ちくりん/たけばやし}: bamboo grove
- {雑木林|ぞうきばやし}: thicket, copse
- {松林|まつばやし}: pine grove
- {林業|りんぎょう}: forestry

Note: {林|はやし} is also a common Japanese surname.
